title: Structure and surface analyses of a newly synthesized acyl thiourea derivative along with its in silico and in vitro investigations for RNR, DNA binding, urease inhibition and radical scavenging activities.
authors: Khalid, Aqsa; Arshad, Nasima; Channar, Pervaiz Ali; Saeed, Aamer; Mir, Muhammad Ismail; Abbas, Qamar; Ejaz, Syeda Abida; Hokelek, Tuncer; Saeed, Amna; Tehzeeb, Arfa
one_liner_zh: 该文合成酰基硫脲衍生物并研究其与DNA的沟槽结合及酶抑制活性，虽涉及DNA结合但非TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验和DFT为主，缺乏AI或MD等本课题核心建模方法。
abstract: N-((4-Acetylphenyl)carbamothioyl)-2,4-dichlorobenzamide (4) was synthesized by the treatment of 2,4-dichlorobenzoyl chloride with potassium thiocyanate in a 1 : 1 molar ratio in dry acetone to afford the 2,4-dichlorobenzoyl isothiocyanate in situ which on reaction with acetyl aniline furnished (4) in good yield and high purity. The compound was confirmed by FTIR, (1)H-NMR, and (13)C-NMR and single crystal X-ray diffraction studies. The planar rings were situated at a dihedral angle of 33.32(6) degrees . The molecules, forming S(6) ring motifs with the intramolecular N-Hcdots, three dots, centeredO hydrogen bonds, were linked through intermolecular C-Hcdots, three dots, centeredO and N-Hcdots, three dots, centeredS hydrogen bonds, enclosing R(2) (2)(8) ring motifs, into infinite double chains along [101]. C-Hcdots, three dots, centeredpi and picdots, three dots, centeredpi interactions with an inter-centroid distance of 3.694 (1) A helped to consolidate a three-dimensional architecture. Hirshfeld surface (HS) analysis further indicated that the most important contributions for the crystal packing were from Hcdots, three dots, centeredC/Ccdots, three dots, centeredH (20.9%), Hcdots, three dots, centeredH (20.5%), Hcdots, three dots, centeredCl/Clcdots, three dots, centeredH (19.4%), Hcdots, three dots, centeredO/Ocdots, three dots, centeredH (13.8%) and Hcdots, three dots, centeredS/Scdots, three dots, centeredH (8.9%) interactions. Thus C-Hcdots, three dots, centeredpi (ring), picdots, three dots, centeredpi, van der Waals interactions and hydrogen bonding played the major roles in the crystal packing. The electronic structure and computed DFT (density functional theory) parameters identified the reactivity profile of compound (4). In silico binding of (4) with RNA indicated the formation of a stable protein-ligand complex via hydrogen bonding, while DNA docking studies inferred (4) as a potent groove binder. The experimentally observed hypochromic change (57.2%) in the UV-visible spectrum of (4) in the presence of varying DNA concentrations together with the evaluated binding parameters (K (b); 7.9 x 10(4) M(-1), DeltaG; -28.42 kJ mol(-1)) indicated spontaneous interaction of (4) with DNA via groove binding and hence supported the findings obtained through docking analysis. This compound also showed excellent urease inhibition activity in both in silico and vitro studies with an IC(50) value of 0.0389 +/- 0.0017 muM. However, the radical scavenging efficiency of (4) was found to be modest in comparison to vitamin C.
abstract_zh: 通过2,4-二氯苯甲酰氯与硫氰酸钾在干燥丙酮中以1：1摩尔比反应，原位生成2,4-二氯苯甲酰异硫氰酸酯，再与乙酰苯胺反应，合成了N-((4-乙酰苯基)氨基硫代甲酰基)-2,4-二氯苯甲酰胺(4)，产率良好且纯度较高。该化合物通过FTIR、¹H-NMR、¹³C-NMR及单晶X射线衍射研究进行了确认。平面环位于二面角33.32(6)°处。分子通过分子内N—H⋯O氢键形成S(6)环状结构，并通过分子间C—H⋯O和N—H⋯S氢键连接，包围R₂²(8)环状结构，沿[101]方向延伸成无限双链。C—H⋯π和π⋯π相互作用（质心间距为3.694(1) Å）有助于巩固三维结构。Hirshfeld表面(HS)分析进一步表明，晶体堆积中最重要的贡献来自H⋯C/C⋯H (20.9%)、H⋯H (20.5%)、H⋯Cl/Cl⋯H (19.4%)、H⋯O/O⋯H (13.8%)和H⋯S/S⋯H (8.9%)相互作用。因此，C—H⋯π（环）、π⋯π、范德华相互作用和氢键在晶体堆积中起主要作用。电子结构和计算DFT（密度泛函理论）参数确定了化合物(4)的反应性特征。化合物(4)与RNA的计算机模拟结合表明，通过氢键形成了稳定的蛋白质-配体复合物，而DNA对接研究推断(4)为强效沟槽结合剂。实验观察到，在不同DNA浓度存在下，化合物(4)的紫外-可见光谱出现减色变化（57.2%），结合评估的结合参数（K_b；7.9 × 10⁴ M⁻¹，ΔG；-28.42 kJ mol⁻¹），表明(4)通过沟槽结合与DNA自发相互作用，从而支持了通过对接分析获得的结果。该化合物在计算机模拟和体外研究中均表现出优异的脲酶抑制活性，IC₅₀值为0.0389 ± 0.0017 μM。然而，与维生素C相比，(4)的自由基清除效率较为一般。
